result.verdict: Render is geometrically faithful to the original: same circle, same chords and interior construction, all labels present. Remaining differences are the size of the point I marker and the dash pattern of BI.

issues.description: Point I marker is a small dot in the render. In the original it is a clearly larger filled dot. The render's marker is roughly a third of the original's diameter.
issues.suggestion: Increase the marker size for I (e.g. \fill (I) circle (3pt) or a larger dot radius) so it matches the original's filled dot.

issues.description: Dashed segment BI: the render's dashes are shorter and more closely spaced than the original's longer dashes with wider gaps.
issues.suggestion: Lengthen the dash pattern for BI (e.g. dash 4pt gap 3pt, or the equivalent pattern that matches the original).
